problem.quote: Your best agents spend their days copying tracking numbers and resending password resets. The conversations that actually need them get answered last.

solution.title: AI takes the volume.
solution.titleAccent: Your team takes the moments that matter.
solution.description: Cardynal isn't here to replace your support team. It's here to make them faster, sharper, and free of the work that's been draining them. AI agents handle the repetitive volume. When something needs judgment, they hand off to a human with the entire conversation, customer history, and context already prepared. No restart. No copy-paste. No lost thread.

cards.title: AI agents that actually act
cards.description: Not chatbots that parrot answers. Cardynal agents call your APIs, update tickets, take payments, schedule meetings. They use the same tools your team uses.

items.question: Will Cardynal replace my support team?
items.answer: No. Cardynal handles the repetitive 80% (returns, status checks, FAQs) so your team can focus on the conversations that need a real human: complex cases, empathy, revenue moments. Your best agents finally get to do their best work.

items.question: Is this for agencies or for in-house teams?
items.answer: Both. Agencies and freelancers run AI support for multiple clients from a single workspace. In-house teams (20+ people) deploy it for their own customers. Multi-workspace mode is built in.

items.question: What happens when the AI can't answer?
items.answer: It escalates to a human with the entire conversation, intent detection, and customer history already prepared. Your agent picks up without a single restart. The customer never feels the seam.

items.question: Do I need a developer?
items.answer: No. Everything is visual: agent canvas, workflow builder, integration marketplace, knowledge editor. We also provide guided onboarding for teams that want a partner, not just software.

items.question: Where does my data live?
items.answer: On EU infrastructure, in our own stack. Cardynal does not pipe your conversations through third-party SaaS. You own your data, you can export it anytime, and we encrypt it end-to-end.

items.question: Which channels are supported?
items.answer: Web chat, email (Gmail), Instagram, Messenger, and API on every plan. WhatsApp (Meta Cloud API or QR) from Growth upward. No per-message fees on any channel.

items.question: Do you support voice and phone agents?
items.answer: Coming soon. Same agent brain as our chat agents, answering live calls. Detection, escalation, full transcript handoff. Join the waitlist below for early access.

items.question: How does pricing work?
items.answer: Flat monthly fee with clear quotas: sessions, agents, inboxes, knowledge sources, workflows. No charges per AI resolution. 14-day free trial. Cancel anytime.

items.question: What LLMs are supported?
items.answer: OpenAI (GPT-4) and Anthropic (Claude). Choose per agent, switch anytime. Embeddings use OpenAI for consistent vector search across your knowledge base.
